summary: Dreeve is a self-hosted analytics dashboard designed to process and display fitness data sourced from Strava. It provides a centralised interface for reviewing activity statistics and performance metrics outside of the proprietary platform. The application is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits athletes and developers who want to own their historical Strava data and view aggregated analytics on a private server.
watchOut: With a small community and low repository visibility, you may need to troubleshoot issues independently if upstream development slows down or integration endpoints change.
deployNotes: Because it packages as container images, you will typically run it via Docker or Kubernetes with persistent volumes configured for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
